task: Making classic hummus with lemon and garlic
query: How do I make classic hummus with lemon and garlic?

goal.title: Make hummus in a food processor
goal.description: Rinse canned chickpeas, combine them with tahini, oil, trimmed garlic and squeezed lemon in a processor, then blend in several passes with additional tahini, oil and white seasoning between passes.
goal.final_state: A beige chickpea paste remains around the blade in the open processor jug. It has been stirred and sampled with a spoon; mouth contact and serving are not visible.

procedure.description: Pull open the chickpea can, carry it to the sink and retrieve a mesh strainer. Pour and shake the chickpeas into the strainer, set the can aside and rinse the chickpeas under running water while shaking them. Move the processor jug beside the sink, lift it and tip the drained chickpeas inside. Put the strainer in the sink and return the filled jug to the counter.

Open the tahini jar and stir its contents with a spoon, but then put the jar down and rinse and rub the spoon under the tap. Shut off the water, lift the jar again and scrape a spoonful of tahini onto the chickpeas. Put the jar aside, change the spoon to the left hand, uncap the oil bottle and fill the spoon with oil. Tip the oil into the processor, return the bottle, wipe the spoon and put it in the small bowl in the sink. Briefly withdraw and inspect the hands.

Adjust the processor blade by its central shaft, briefly move between garlic on the board and the jug, then take a knife. Hold and trim garlic cloves on the board, repeatedly repositioning them and scraping their skins. Put the knife down to pull away papery skin with the fingertips, pick it up for additional trimming, then peel again. Drop the peeled clove into the jug, retrieve another piece, cut it into smaller pieces and drop those into the jug too.

Put the knife down and lift a previously cut lemon half. Separate the lemon pieces, hold the half above the processor and repeatedly squeeze and work its pulp with the fingertips. Put the squeezed half on the board, pick up and fit the processor lid, seat the motor on it, then extend and untangle the power cord and plug it into the wall outlet.

Reposition the processor and press its motor button to blend the ingredients. Remove and set down the motor and lid, retrieve a spoon from the drawer and stir and lift a sample of the coarse chickpea mixture. Exchange spoons at the drawer, retrieve the tahini jar and scrape another spoonful into the processor. Put the spoon in the sink, pour additional oil directly from its bottle, return the jar and fit the lid and motor again.

Hold the processor button for a longer blend, producing a finer beige paste. Remove and set down the motor and lid, retrieve the spoon, scrape the walls and stir and lift another sample. Mouth contact is out of view. Retrieve the small shaker, shake white seasoning into the jug and return the shaker to the counter.

Replace the lid and motor, run a final short blend, remove and set down the motor and uncover the jug. Retrieve the spoon, stir and scrape the paste and lift another sample before lowering the spoon near the sink. Pick up the processor lid again at the very end. The paste remains in the processor jug; transfer to a serving bowl is not shown.

query: How do I make creamy blue cheese dip?

goal.title: Make blue cheese dip and serve with crackers
goal.description: Measure sour cream, mayonnaise and blue cheese into a bowl, stir in a spoonful of white liquid and visible seasonings, then transfer the dip to a blue serving bowl and arrange crackers around it.
goal.final_state: The blue bowl of thick white cheese dip sits on a white plate surrounded by crackers. The bowl was briefly placed in and immediately retrieved from the refrigerator.

procedure.description: Open the wall cupboard, take a white mixing bowl and carry it to the counter. Reposition a cream-colored mug, lift and open the sour cream tub, set its lid beside the sink and pick up a teaspoon. Repeatedly spoon sour cream into the mug. Put the tub down, lift the mug and scrape its contents into the white bowl.

Set the mug and teaspoon down and open the blue-lidded mayonnaise jar. Turn and shake the jar over the mug, but no substantial flow is visible. Open the drawer, retrieve a tablespoon and repeatedly scoop mayonnaise into the mug instead. Set the jar aside, lift the mug and use the smaller spoon to scrape its contents into the mixing bowl. Set the mug down and release the spoon.

Lift and open a nearly empty blue cheese tub. Invert it over the cream mug and tap its base to release the remaining crumbles. Set it aside and open a second, fuller tub, removing its lid and peeling off the inner plastic seal. Pour more crumbles into the mug, set the tub down, then tip the mug over the white bowl. Use the teaspoon to scrape the remaining cheese and creamy residue into the bowl, then place the mug on the back counter.

Retrieve the tablespoon, transfer it to the right hand and pick up the teal cup with the left. Scoop a spoonful of opaque white liquid from the cup and add it to the mixing bowl; its exact identity is not established by visible packaging. Leave the tablespoon in the cup and set it down. Pick up the teaspoon and repeatedly stir the cheese and creamy ingredients. Open the pepper grinder, grind pepper over the mixture and set it down. Open a separate seasoning jar, shake orange-tan powder over the dip, close and set down that jar, then stir the seasonings through.

Bring a small blue serving bowl beside the mixture. Lift the white mixing bowl, tilt it over the blue bowl and repeatedly scrape the dip into it with the teaspoon. Put the white bowl and spoon in the sink, pick up the blue bowl and carry it to the refrigerator. Open the refrigerator, place the bowl on a shelf and close the door.

Pause briefly, reopen the refrigerator and retrieve the blue bowl almost immediately. Carry it back to the counter and set it on a white plate. Lift and open the rectangular cracker container, place its lid aside and repeatedly take crackers with both hands, arranging them on the plate around the blue bowl. Withdraw the hands, leaving the dip and crackers together. This is a brief refrigerator placement rather than evidence of a long chilling period.

query: How do I make Ham and Cheese Roll-Ups?

goal.title: Make cheese rolls filled with deli meat
goal.description: Unpack cheese and deli meat, cut the meat into strips and roll it inside two cheese slices. Plate both rolls and carry them to the nearby table.
goal.final_state: Two cheese-wrapped meat rolls remain on a white rectangular plate held above the table. No heating or eating is shown.

procedure.description: Approach the counter and move the empty white rectangular plate to the left of the cutting board. Pick up the teal cheese package, open it and remove the stacked slices. Peel off the white separator papers, lay two cheese slices on the board and put the papers beside the package.

Pull back the film on the deli meat package, lift out the thin pale slices and move the package beside the sink. Separate and lay the meat on the cutting board, moving the cheese out of the cutting area.

Take the long knife from the countertop knife block. Hold the meat with the left fingertips and slice it lengthwise into narrow strips using the right hand. Pull the cut strips apart and align them near the upper edge of the board while retaining the knife.

Move a cheese slice into the clear lower part of the board and put the knife down beside the sink. Curl the cheese edge, open it again, pick up and fold meat strips and place them along the edge. Add another strip, roll the cheese around the meat and transfer the first completed roll to the plate.

Move the second cheese slice into position, add folded meat strips along its edge and begin rolling. Retrieve further strips in several passes and tuck them into the developing roll. Continue curling and pressing the cheese until it forms a cylinder, then place the second roll on the plate.

Lift the plate with both hands and carry it from the counter to the nearby table. After the last annotated step at 112.5s, continue holding it above the table. Around 115.8–120.8s the right fingertips lift and reposition one roll on the plate, then release it while the left hand retains the plate. Both rolls remain visible at the end; no eating or heating is shown.

task: Creating a quick washi tape design on paper
query: How do I create a quick washi tape design on paper?

goal.title: Draw a face on a patterned tape panel
goal.description: Align strips of patterned adhesive tape across a white sheet, trim the excess, then draw a face on the taped area with a green marker and display it.
goal.final_state: A green face is visible on a rectangular panel of patterned tape adhered to the white paper. The paper is displayed and then returned toward the desk.

procedure.description: Clear space on the desk, center the white paper and place the semicircular protractor across it. Retrieve and uncap the green marker, hold the protractor against the paper and draw a horizontal line along its straight edge. Move the protractor below the line.

Put the marker aside and take the patterned adhesive tape roll. Spend several attempts locating and lifting its edge, pull a strip across the paper to gauge its length, then cut it with scissors. Put the scissors down and move the protractor and roll out of the working area. Straighten the loose strip, align it with the guideline, lower it onto the paper and smooth it flat.

Unroll and cut a second strip. Set the roll aside, straighten the curling strip and align it adjacent to the first. Press it onto the paper, lift the sheet to inspect, then use scissors to trim the tape extending beyond each paper edge. Rotate the sheet between cuts, peel away the offcuts and attach them to the front edge of the desk. Lay the paper down and press the strips flat.

Take the roll again, pull out a third strip, raise it and cut across it. Set the roll aside, straighten the cut strip, carefully align it above the existing tape and smooth it down. Lift the paper edge, trim the projecting tape and remove the offcut to the desk front before lowering the scissors.

Pull out and cut a fourth strip of the same tape. Straighten it, align it beside the other strips and press it onto the paper to widen the patterned panel. Lift and rotate the sheet to trim both projecting ends, peel away the offcuts and press the completed tape panel flat.

Retrieve the green marker and draw a large oval outline across the taped area while the other hand steadies the sheet. Add two eyes, a central nose and a wide rectangular mouth. Retrace the eyes and add short lines around the mouth. The left fingers press the supported paper rather than lifting it during drawing.

Move the cap from the back of the marker onto its tip using both hands and set the capped marker beside the marker box. Lift the paper with both hands to display the face drawn on the patterned tape panel. After the final human fine boundary at 342.7s the sheet continues to be displayed and is lowered onto the desk near the end; no additional drawing is visible.

query: How do I decorate a sketchbook with stickers?

goal.title: Decorate a notebook page with stickers
goal.description: Open a spiral notebook, arrange a selection of decorative stickers on its right page, then peel their backings and press them into the planned layout.
goal.final_state: The notebook remains open on the tray. Its right page holds lettering, flower, illustrated and cactus stickers; the left page is blank. Spare stickers and discarded white backings remain beside it.

procedure.description: Open the spiral notebook to a blank lined spread on the wooden lap tray. Retrieve a stack of die-cut stickers from the right, thumb through designs and lay a small lettering design on the right page, moving it upward. Place a larger black script design below it. The stickers are initially laid out with their backing papers still attached.

Flip through further designs in the left hand and set aside one green lettering piece. Place an illustrated design at the upper right, red lettering at the lower right, a small lettering design beside the spiral and a green cactus along the right edge. Add a flower near the upper lettering and adjust nearby pieces.

Select a brown lettering design and place it near the middle right. Continue sorting the remaining stack, move unused designs aside and rearrange the loose stickers on the page to refine their spacing. Put the spare stack on the right side of the tray.

Lift the small lettering piece from the layout, work a fingernail under its white backing, peel it off and return the adhesive sticker to the upper part of the page. Press it down and put the backing on a growing pile at the tray upper right. Repeat for the illustrated upper-right design, then move the nearby loose pieces around the flower.

Lift the flower, pick and peel its backing and smooth it onto the page. Peel and attach the black lettering piece next. Lift the cactus from the layout, repeatedly work at its edge, pull off its backing, align it near the right edge and press it flat. Put the removed papers on the upper-right pile.

Move loose designs aside to reach an oval lettering sticker, peel away its backing and stick it in the central-left space. Peel and attach the large black script below it. Remove the red lettering design backing, place it on the center-right and rub it flat. Separate white backings are discarded onto the tray pile after these placements.

Take the brown lettering design from beside the notebook. Spend repeated fingernail attempts lifting its backing while holding the small piece near the bottom of view. Once separated, align it at the lower right, smooth its edges and discard the backing. Retrieve the spare sticker stack.

Select a final small design from the spare stack and work at its backing edge near the lap, with the exact edge partly hidden by the fingertips. Put its white backing on the upper-right pile, align the small sticker along the bottom of the right page and press it down. Withdraw the hands, leaving the decorated right page open beside a blank left page.

task: Making microwave scrambled eggs with cheese and salsa
query: How do I make microwave scrambled eggs with cheese and salsa?

goal.title: Prepare microwave eggs with cheese and salsa
goal.description: Crack two eggs into a bowl and beat them with milk. Microwave in two rounds, stirring and salting between rounds, then top the cooked eggs with shredded cheese and salsa.
goal.final_state: A yellow bowl of puffed cooked eggs topped with shredded cheese and a mound of salsa rests on the worktop. The fork lies beside it and the salsa jar is closed.

procedure.description: Pick up and tap an egg against the counter, split the shell over the yellow bowl, then repeat with a second egg. Move empty shells aside and pinch at a possible shell fragment inside the bowl. Unscrew the carton cap, pour milk into the raw eggs, recap and set down the carton, then beat the mixture with a fork while holding the bowl.

Lift the bowl, leave the fork on the counter and carry the bowl to the microwave. Open the door with the left hand, place the bowl inside with the right, close the door and press the control to start. Wait beside the running microwave, then open it before the displayed countdown has finished and retrieve the bowl.

Carry the bowl back to the worktop, take up the fork and stir the still-fluid, partly cooked eggs. Hold the fork in the right hand while the left picks up the salt shaker, shakes salt over the mixture and returns the shaker. Stir again and lift the bowl.

Set the fork down, carry the bowl to the still-open microwave and transfer it to the right hand. Place it on the turntable, close the door, set the controls and start a second heating period. Wait beside the appliance, open it with17seconds still displayed and remove the now puffed egg mixture. Carry the bowl back and lower it onto the worktop.

Pick up the fork and briefly pause beside the cooked eggs. Put the fork down, open the shredded-cheese bag and shake cheese directly over the eggs. Reseal and set aside the bag, open the salsa jar and put its lid down. Use the fork to scoop salsa from the tilted jar onto the cheese-topped eggs, lay the fork down, close the jar and leave the completed bowl on the counter.

query: How do I make stovetop cheese pasta?

goal.title: Make stovetop macaroni with cheese sauce
goal.description: Drain already-cooked macaroni, make a milk, butter and shredded mozzarella sauce in the emptied pan, combine and season the pasta, then scrape it into a white serving bowl.
goal.final_state: Macaroni in pale cheese sauce rests in a white bowl with a fork. The pan is back on the stove with some sauce left inside.

procedure.description: The clip begins with pasta already boiling in a covered pan. Adjust the stove, hold the lid knob briefly, grip the hot pan with a red oven mitt, remove the lid and set it on the rear pan. Carry the hot pan to the sink, move a cup out of the way and retrieve a mesh strainer. Pour out cooking water, then tip the pasta into the strainer. Return both to the stove and cover the pasta-filled strainer on the rear pan.

Adjust the front burner, fetch a glass from the sink and set it on the counter. Retrieve wrapped butter and a knife, cut off butter into the emptied front pan and set the wrapper aside. Adjust the burner again, move the milk carton near the stove, pick up a fork and push the butter around the pan; a solid chunk remains at the end of this phase.

Lift and uncap the milk carton while setting the fork aside, pour milk into the pan, recap and return the carton. Open a bag of shredded mozzarella and pour it into the milk in two passes. Set the bag aside, move the carton, retrieve the fork and repeatedly stir the milk, cheese and butter into a pale sauce.

Remove the lid from the pasta-filled strainer, lift the strainer and tip the pasta into the cheese sauce, scraping remaining pieces out with the fork. Put the empty strainer on the rear pan and stir the pasta thoroughly. Replace the lid over the strainer, move a white serving bowl beside the stove and continue stirring before leaving the fork in the pan.

Open the green-lidded seasoning jar, shake pale granules over the pasta, close and return the jar. Stir with the fork, open the white salt container, shake it over the pasta, close and put it down. Stir again and grasp the hot pan handle through the oven mitt.

Lift and tilt the pan over the white bowl. Keep holding its handle with the left mitt while repeatedly scraping macaroni and sauce into the bowl with the right-hand fork. Stop pouring while some pale sauce remains in the pan, return the pan to the stove and stir the macaroni in the bowl. Briefly lift the bowl, lower it to the counter and release it with the fork left inside.

task: Making stuffed mini sweet peppers with herbed cheese
query: How do I make stuffed mini sweet peppers with herbed cheese?

goal.title: Prepare creamy stuffed mini peppers
goal.description: Wash and dry four small bell peppers, trim their tops and scrape out the interiors. Mix chopped herbs and pinched seasonings into a prepared creamy filling, spoon it into all four peppers and arrange them on a plate.
goal.final_state: Four uncooked peppers with creamy filling visible at their open ends lie arranged on a plate. No heating or tasting is shown.

procedure.description: Gather four small bell peppers from the cutting board, carry them to the sink, turn on the faucet and spread a towel beside the basin. Rotate and rub each pepper individually under running water, putting the washed peppers on the towel. Turn the faucet off after washing the fourth.
Fold the towel over the peppers and rub and roll them inside it. Uncover them, gather all four, carry them back to the kitchen counter and lay them on the cutting board.

Move the empty scrap bowl beside the board and take the knife. Hold each pepper in turn and cut across its stem end, placing the detached top into the scrap bowl. Set the knife down after cutting the fourth pepper.
Leave the counter and look over the dining table for several seconds, without visible food preparation, then return to the peppers.

Take a small metal spoon. Hold each trimmed pepper over the scrap bowl and repeatedly scrape its inside while turning it in the left hand. Drop the loosened seeds and inner material into the bowl and return each hollow pepper to the board.

Put down the scraping utensil and pick chopped green herbs from the board in several pinches, dropping them into the already prepared creamy filling. Stir with the spoon while holding the bowl. Add pinches from each of the two small white bowls, then stir again. The exact identities of the creamy base and these seasonings are not established visually.
Pause to tap the phone lying on the stove. Return to the counter, hold the filling bowl and stir and scrape the mixture with the spoon, then reach for the first hollow pepper.

Hold the first pepper in the left hand and repeatedly spoon creamy filling into its open end, pressing and leveling it with the spoon; place it on the plate. Fill the red pepper and return it to the board, then fill the two remaining yellow peppers one at a time, putting one on the board and retaining the last in the left hand.

Move the filled peppers from the board to the plate, first handling the yellow peppers and then the red pepper. Pause to tap the phone again, then retrieve the final yellow pepper and arrange all four stuffed peppers on the plate. Withdraw both hands and look at the finished plate until the clip ends. No baking or eating is shown.

query: How do I replace a nightlight bulb?

goal.title: Replace the bedside lamp bulb
goal.description: Unplug the bedside lamp, unscrew and remove its installed bulb, screw in another bulb, align the shade, reconnect the power plug and turn the lamp on.
goal.final_state: The replacement bulb is seated beneath the black shade and visibly illuminated; the removed bulb remains on the bedside table.

procedure.description: Approach the wall outlet, grasp the upper black power plug with the right hand and pull it free. Leave the separate lower plug inserted.
Walk to the bedside table and look down through the black lamp shade at the bulb. Briefly touch the shade and its inner support, withdraw the hand, then reach toward the bulb.

Grip the installed bulb with the right hand and repeatedly rotate and regrip it to unscrew it. Lift its threaded base clear of the socket, lower it beside the giraffe ornament on the bedside table and release it.

Pick up the other bulb from the table and turn it between both hands. Raise it above the shade, lower its screw base into the lamp socket and rotate it with the right hand. Briefly release and regrip, then continue turning it repeatedly until it stays seated.

Release the bulb, hold opposite sides of the black shade and straighten it. Let go, step toward the wall outlet and lift the loose plug. Turn and align its prongs with the upper receptacle and press it fully in.

Release the connected plug and return to the lamp. Reach around the lamp below the shade; the control itself is hidden. The installed bulb becomes visibly illuminated around82s. Withdraw and step back while the lamp remains on.

goal.description: Measure oats and add an unlabelled brown dry ingredient, peanut butter and honey. Mix into a sticky mass, flatten it on parchment over a plate, briefly place it in the freezer, then cut it into four bars and carry the plate to a table.
goal.final_state: Four oat bars rest on parchment over a round plate. The plate is being lowered at a table; the knife has been left in the mixing bowl.

procedure.description: Flatten parchment over a round plate, open the wall cupboard and remove a white bowl. Close the cupboard, lower the bowl to the counter, pick up and open the oat canister. Lift a small white dish of an unlabelled beige-brown crumbly ingredient. Spoon several portions into the oats, put the dish down and stir the dry ingredients repeatedly, briefly lifting the bowl. Scrape oats from the small spoon with a finger.

Hold the slab steady with left fingertips while making repeated parallel knife cuts through it, separating it into four narrow bars. query: How do I decorate a pen holder with stickers?

goal.title: Decorate a pen holder with stickers
goal.description: Wipe a translucent cup, prepare and peel assorted graphic and text stickers, press them onto different faces and smooth the edges. Finish with smaller accents, then place two pens in the decorated cup.
goal.final_state: The decorated cup stands on the wooden desk holding teal and purple pens.

procedure.description: Lift the translucent cup and wipe its wall and base with a white tissue, turning it in the left hand before lowering it onto the wooden desk.

Fold and put the tissue aside, spread the die-cut stickers, and use large teal scissors to trim the straight bottom edge of a black-and-white text sticker. Put it down, sort several designs and select an orange outlined triangular graphic.
Repeatedly pick at the orange sticker edge until its white backing separates. Pick up the cup, align the graphic on its side, press it down and rub its edges while rotating the cup.

Set the cup down and choose the large conservation figure sticker. Work its edge and peel away the backing. Lift the cup, align then lift and realign the graphic on another face, and press its center and outline flat before putting the cup down.
Choose the green-and-orange text sticker, peel its backing and retrieve the cup. Turn a blank face toward the sticker, apply it diagonally and smooth the individual letters and edges.

Gather discarded backing paper and retrieve the trimmed black-and-white text sticker. Make repeated fingernail attempts before removing its backing. Lift the cup, position and reposition the label across another face, then smooth it and nearby overlapping edges.

Peel a small purple accent and press it near the upper rim; then peel a red heart and attach it below the text. Set the cup down, sort scraps and remaining stickers, briefly lift and return the scissors without visible cutting, and choose another small purple animal-shaped design.

Continue working the same small purple sticker edge for an extended time, finally separating its backing at about 223s. Lower the backing, grasp and lift the cup, and bring the sticker to the open area below the colored text.

Press the small purple graphic flat, rub its edges and rotate the cup to smooth the other attached stickers. Stand the decorated cup on the desk, retrieve the teal and purple pens, and lower both pens into it at about 245.1–245.5s. The final view shows the pen-filled decorated cup.

goal.title: Prepare and store a blended mango mixture
goal.description: Peel and cut a mango, blend its flesh with lemon juice and sugar, scrape the mixture into a covered storage box and place it in the freezer. Reopen the box and stir it with a spoon.
goal.final_state: A coarse yellow mango mixture sits in an uncovered box at the open freezer. The green lid and spoon remain held; successful freezing, serving and eating are not shown.

procedure.description: Hold the whole unpeeled mango and take a knife. Make repeated cutting attempts while rotating the fruit, but no cheek separates. Put down the knife, pick at the surface sticker, move to the utensil drawer and retrieve a black Y-shaped peeler before returning to the board.

Peel successive sides of the mango with repeated downward strokes, turning it in the left hand between strokes. Skin strips accumulate on the cutting board. Put the peeler down when most of the yellow flesh is exposed.

Take the knife and slice alongside the pit to separate broad cheeks and smaller side strips. Rotate and reposition the remaining fruit for further cuts. Set the exposed flattened pit to the left, then cut the flesh into chunks and lower the knife onto the board.
Lift several handfuls of chopped mango into the open blender jug. Adjust the jug on its base, briefly turn the black central blade shaft, and continue picking up and dropping the remaining chunks.

Take the green lemon juice bottle, unscrew its cap and pour liquid into the mango-filled jug. Replace the cap and set the bottle down. Take the clear sugar shaker, pour white granules into the jug, set the shaker down and fit the black lid.

Hold the lid with the left hand and operate the blender buttons with the right. Stop and lift the lid, take the blue spatula and scrape mixture from the jug walls. Replace the lid and run the blender again. Remove the lid, pull out the central blade assembly and lay it on the cutting board.

Lift the jug by its handle, tilt it over a clear rectangular storage box and scrape the coarse yellow mixture into the box using the spatula. Return the nearly empty jug to its base and spread the mixture inside the box.

Pick up the green lid and lift the box. Carry it to the freezer and pull the door open while keeping the spatula. Set the box at the opening, smooth the mixture further, press the lid on and place the covered box on an upper shelf. Shift another food package to make room, withdraw and close the door.

Carry the spatula to the dish rack and put it down. Open the utensil drawer and fetch a spoon. Return directly to the freezer, reopen it, bring the box to the opening and remove its green lid. Peel successive sides of the mango with repeated downward strokes, turning it in the left hand between strokes. Skin strips accumulate on the cutting board. Put the peeler down when most of the yellow flesh is exposed.

Take the knife and slice alongside the pit to separate broad cheeks and smaller side strips. Rotate and reposition the remaining fruit for further cuts. Set the exposed flattened pit to the left, then cut the flesh into chunks and lower the knife onto the board.
Lift several handfuls of chopped mango into the open blender jug. Adjust the jug on its base, briefly turn the black central blade shaft, and continue picking up and dropping the remaining chunks.

Take the green lemon juice bottle, unscrew its cap and pour liquid into the mango-filled jug. Replace the cap and set the bottle down. Take the clear sugar shaker, pour white granules into the jug, set the shaker down and fit the black lid.

Hold the lid with the left hand and operate the blender buttons with the right. Stop and lift the lid, take the blue spatula and scrape mixture from the jug walls. Replace the lid and run the blender again. Remove the lid, pull out the central blade assembly and lay it on the cutting board.

Lift the jug by its handle, tilt it over a clear rectangular storage box and scrape the coarse yellow mixture into the box using the spatula. Return the nearly empty jug to its base and spread the mixture inside the box.

Pick up the green lid and lift the box. Carry it to the freezer and pull the door open while keeping the spatula. Set the box at the opening, smooth the mixture further, press the lid on and place the covered box on an upper shelf. Shift another food package to make room, withdraw and close the door.

Carry the spatula to the dish rack and put it down. Open the utensil drawer and fetch a spoon. Return directly to the freezer, reopen it, bring the box to the opening and remove its green lid. Stir and scrape the mixture with the spoon while holding the lid in the other hand. Finish paused beside the uncovered box; no serving or visibly frozen result is shown.

query: How do I make baked wonton chips?

goal.title: Bake seasoned wonton wrapper squares
goal.description: Open and separate square wonton wrappers, cut them into smaller squares and arrange them on a tray. Spray with oil, heat in the toaster oven with repeated inspections, remove with a towel, sprinkle salt and transfer the pieces to a small plate.
goal.final_state: Pale square wrapper pieces are piled on a small plate after heating and salting; the tray is moved away. Texture and doneness cannot be verified from the silent image alone.

procedure.description: Bring the wonton wrapper package to the cutting board and try pulling its sealed edge apart. Retrieve the chef knife, slit the plastic seam and put the knife down. Pull the opening wider, remove a square stack and move the package aside.
Separate the stuck wrapper sheets by lifting and peeling their edges apart. Lay the individual square wrappers flat in a two-by-two arrangement on the board.

Retrieve the knife and steady each wrapper with the left hand. Saw across the wrappers in one direction, reposition the blade and cut across them again in the perpendicular direction to make smaller square pieces.

Put the knife down. Repeatedly pick up and separate the small wrapper pieces and spread them in a single layer on the metal baking tray. Lift the tray and pump the oil dispenser nozzle across the pieces, then return the dispenser and carry the tray toward the toaster oven.
Open the toaster oven, slide the tray onto its rack and close the door. Turn the control dial and press the start control; the interior light illuminates.

Wait facing the lit oven. Briefly open and close the door at about 158s, adjust the control dial at about 165–172s as the light cycles, then resume waiting. Open and close the door for another inspection at about 199–202s and again at about 216–221s without visibly handling the food.

Open the door again. Use a folded towel to grip and remove the hot tray, carry it back to the cutting board and keep supporting it. Remove the lid from the salt crock and repeatedly sprinkle pinches of salt across the wrapper squares.

Retrieve the small plate and put it beside the tray. After the preserved fine track ends at 245s, use a teal-handled fork to loosen and push the wrapper pieces while tilting the tray over the plate at about 245.5–251.5s. Scrape remaining pieces free and transfer the final piece by hand at about 255s. Move the tray away; the final view shows the pale seasoned squares on the plate. Crispness is not established by the silent video.

query: How do I iron a pair of pants?

goal.title: Iron and hang a pair of jeans
goal.description: Align the jeans on an ironing board and adjust the iron. Repeatedly turn and straighten the garment to press its front and rear sections, switching hands for the lower legs. Clip the waistband onto a hanger with two wooden pegs and hang it from the wardrobe handle.
goal.final_state: The jeans hang from a black hanger attached to the wardrobe handle, secured at the waistband with two wooden clothespins. The iron rests upright beside the ironing board.

procedure.description: Lift the jeans from the board, manipulate and align the elastic waistband, then lay one leg lengthwise on the board. Pull its hem and seams straight and sweep both hands across the fabric to flatten it.

Retrieve the iron from beside the board and adjust its upper control with the left fingers. Pull and smooth the waist, hold the white drawstring aside, make initial pressing strokes over the upper front, then smooth the long leg by hand.

Run the iron back and forth along the first front-facing leg and over the pocket and thigh while the left hand steadies the waistband. Finish toward the lower leg, lift the iron and stand it upright beside the board.

Lift and turn the jeans so a rear pocket faces up. Smooth and align the fabric, retrieve the iron and make repeated strokes over the rear pocket and down the leg. Return the iron to its upright resting position.

Lift and reorient the garment to expose the other rear-facing section. Pull the hem and seams straight, smooth the leg, steady the waist and iron over the rear pocket and upper leg. Transfer the iron into the left hand for lower-leg strokes, transfer it back and stand it upright.

Turn the garment front side up again and realign the other leg on the board. Retrieve the iron, keep the drawstring clear and press the upper front and thigh. Switch to the left hand to press toward the hem, put the iron upright and lift and spread the jeans flat on the board.

Turn to the nearby chair, collect the black hanger and two wooden clothespins and return. Position the waistband against the hanger lower bar. Squeeze and release a wooden peg to secure one side, align the opposite side and secure it with the second peg.

Lift the hanger carrying the clipped jeans, move toward the wardrobe and shift a small storage box out of the way. Close the wardrobe door with the free left hand and lower the hanger hook onto its handle. Release the hanger, leaving the jeans suspended by the two clothespins.

goal.title: Prepare a blueberry banana spinach protein smoothie
goal.description: Open the ingredients, measure blueberries and banana into a beaker, add spinach and milk, then add protein and collagen powders. Assemble and plug in an immersion blender, blend the mixture and pour the purple smoothie into a stemmed glass.
goal.final_state: A full stemmed glass of purple foamy smoothie is held toward the camera; remaining mixture and the detached blender shaft are in the beaker.

procedure.description: Approach arranged ingredients. Move the clear blending beaker forward, position blueberry and sliced-banana containers beside it, unscrew the milk carton cap and set it aside.

Lift and open the protein powder tub, set its white lid down and retrieve its scoop. Lift and open the green-lidded collagen tub, set its lid down and reach inside to locate its scoop. No powder is added to the beaker during this preparation.
Reposition the banana container, remove the yellow clip from the spinach bag, pull its top open and stand the bag on the counter.
Hold the blueberry container with the left hand and repeatedly transfer rounded spoonfuls of blueberries into the blending beaker. Return the berry container to the counter.
Lift the sliced-banana container and repeatedly scoop banana pieces into the beaker. Put the container down, lift and lower the beaker briefly and leave the measuring spoon in the banana container.

Reach into the spinach bag, lift a handful and put it into the beaker, pressing the leaves below its rim. Set the bag down, lift the open milk carton and pour milk in. Steady and briefly raise the beaker to inspect its layers, add more milk and return the carton upright.

Lift the open protein powder tub, fill its scoop and empty the scoop over the beaker, tapping out the powder before returning the scoop. Lift the collagen tub, fill its scoop, tip it over the ingredients and return the scoop and tub.

Lift and examine the filled beaker, put it back on the counter and screw the cap onto the milk carton. Retrieve the metal blender shaft and black motor, move the spinach bag aside, arrange the cord and insert the plug into the wall socket.

Join and position the immersion blender in the beaker. Hold its motor in the right hand and steady the beaker with the left. Press the control and move the shaft through the ingredients until the mixture is uniformly purple and foamy. Detach and put aside the motor, leaving the shaft in the beaker.

Lift and tilt the beaker, hold the shaft near its rim and pour the thick purple mixture into the stemmed glass. Return the beaker upright and put it down, lift the full glass and hold it toward the camera for presentation. No drinking is visible.

query: How do I create a paper windmill?

goal.title: Make a paper pinwheel on a wooden rod
goal.description: Trim a paper square, crease both diagonals and cut four inward slits. Fold alternating corners to the center, secure them with a tiny fastener and attach the center to a thin wooden rod.
goal.final_state: A four-bladed pale paper pinwheel is attached at its center to a thin wooden rod and laid on the table. The video does not establish free rotation under airflow.

procedure.description: Hold the pale paper sheet in the left hand and use scissors in the right to trim a narrow strip and remaining edge, producing a square. Put the scissors beside the sheet and lay the square on the table.
Bring opposite corners together diagonally to form a triangle. Smooth the fold, lift its edge and pinch along the crease, then unfold the square.
Bring the other pair of corners together, align the layers and crease the second diagonal by pressing and pinching it. Open the sheet again, revealing crossing diagonal creases.

Pick up the scissors, cut from one corner along a diagonal toward but short of the center, rotate the sheet and repeat at the remaining three corners. Leave an uncut central area and put the scissors down.
Lay the slit square flat. Bring one cut corner inward and press it, rotate the paper as needed and repeat with alternating corners, gathering four tips at the center to make four angled blades.

Lift and steady the gathered blades, retrieve a tiny fastener from the table and push it through or into the overlapping center with the right fingers. Its exact type and connection are too small to resolve.

Retrieve a thin wooden rod, align its tip behind the pinwheel center and work the central fastener while holding the paper and rod together. Turn the assembly forward and adjust the center until the four blades remain gathered on the rod.
Hold and turn the assembled paper pinwheel by its rod, inspect the center and blades, then lay it on the table. A free spin under wind is not demonstrated.

task: Making banana, kiwi, and strawberry skewers
query: How do I make banana, kiwi, and strawberry skewers?

goal.title: Make banana kiwi and strawberry skewers
goal.description: Rinse and prepare banana, kiwi and strawberries, cut the fruit into chunks and slices, and alternate the pieces on two long wooden skewers.
goal.final_state: Two loaded fruit skewers lie side by side on the amber plate at the end of the video.

procedure.description: Carry a banana and strawberries over the sink, operate the faucet and hold the fruit under running water. Put the strawberries on the amber plate and turn the faucet off.
Snap and pull the banana skin downward, briefly use the knife on the skin, then pull away the remaining peel. Put the peeled banana on the plate and move the peel aside while retrieving a kiwi.
Hold and rotate the kiwi while paring away long strips of brown skin with the knife. Repeatedly shave the remaining patches, then lower the peeled fruit to the plate.
Slice the kiwi into thick green rounds. Reposition the banana, crosscut it into chunks and rearrange pieces as cutting progresses.
Pick up the strawberries individually, cut off their leafy tops and move the caps aside. Halve the hulled berries and rearrange the prepared fruit on the plate.

Set the knife aside and retrieve a long wooden skewer. Alternately pierce banana chunks, strawberry halves and kiwi slices, sliding each down the stick. Finish loading the first skewer and place it to the right of the plate.
Retrieve another skewer and pierce a banana chunk, beginning the second fruit skewer. The supplied human fine divisions stop during this operation.
In the uncovered tail, slide the banana down the second stick, add kiwi, strawberry, more banana and further fruit pieces, and lay this second loaded skewer on the plate.
Retrieve the first skewer from the right, add a remaining banana piece, then lay both loaded fruit skewers side by side on the plate and adjust their arrangement.

goal.title: Make celery snacks with peanut butter and raisins
goal.description: Wash and dry celery, trim and crosscut it, spread peanut butter into each piece, arrange raisins over the filling and transfer the snacks to a plate.
goal.final_state: Several short celery pieces filled with peanut butter and topped with raisins are arranged on the white plate.

procedure.description: Pull celery sticks out of a clear package, carry them over the sink, turn the faucet on and rub and turn them under running water. Stop the water and move the stalks onto a towel.
Fold the towel around the celery and press it dry. Carry the dried stalks to the small wooden cutting board and pick up the knife.

Trim stalk ends, moving each celery stalk across the board and setting cut ends near the discarded package. Reposition the trimmed stalks and cut them crosswise into shorter snack pieces. Rest the knife alongside the board.
Leave the worktop briefly, walk to an adjacent room and press a wall switch, then return. Move the package aside and pull open the utensil drawer.

Retrieve a spoon, lift the peanut butter jar and unscrew its lid. Scoop peanut butter, set the jar down, hold a celery piece in the left hand and spread the paste along its groove before returning it to the board.
Pause food preparation to tap several screens on the smartphone at the counter while keeping the spoon in the other hand.

Resume scooping peanut butter from the jar. Alternate between scraping its inner walls, setting the jar down, lifting successive celery pieces, smoothing peanut butter into their grooves and replacing them on the board. Scrape progressively lower inside the nearly empty jar.
Spread the last loaded spoonful along another celery piece, put the celery down and rest the spoon in the jar. Retrieve and pull open the red raisin bag.

Hold the bag in the left hand, take raisins with the right fingertips and place them in rows along the peanut butter in the celery pieces. Repeatedly return to the bag, press and reposition raisins, and recover loose raisins from the board and counter. Set the bag aside.

Lift the filled celery pieces in pairs and carry them from the cutting board to the white plate. Transfer the remaining pieces, adjust their spacing, then withdraw the hands and look at the finished plate.

goal.title: Prepare a hummus and vegetable wrap
goal.description: Rub and cut the vegetables, spread mixed hummus over a tortilla, layer cucumber lettuce tomato avocado and shredded cheese, then fold, roll and halve the wrap.
goal.final_state: Two cut wrap halves are arranged on a raised serving plate with the vegetable filling visible.

procedure.description: Lift a plate holding lettuce, cucumber and a tomato. Hold a white bowl in the left hand while rubbing and turning the lettuce inside it, return the lettuce to the vegetable plate and retrieve the cucumber.

Roll and rub the cucumber over a white catch plate, replace it and repeat with the tomato. Lift the bowl and rub the tomato inside it, put the bowl and tomato down and move the catch plate aside. Lift and briefly tilt the vegetable plate above the bowl while retaining the produce, then lay the lettuce on the cutting board.

Pick up the patterned chef knife, chop the lettuce crosswise into strips and gather it. Put the cucumber on the board, trim a tip and repeatedly cut it lengthwise into sticks, then retrieve the tomato.

Saw through the tomato to make thick rounds, set the remaining tomato piece aside, halve the rounds and transfer the half-moons to the vegetable plate. Scoop chopped lettuce and cucumber sticks onto the same plate and put the remaining tomato in the white bowl.

Rest the chef knife across the tortilla, bring its serving plate onto the cutting board, retrieve the hummus tub and take the butter knife. Remove the clear lid, peel off the inner film and place both pieces aside.

Hold the tub in the left hand and stir the darker red topping into the orange hummus with the butter knife. Scoop hummus onto the tortilla and repeatedly spread it into a broad strip through the center. Rest the butter knife in the tub, set the tub aside and move the chef knife onto the tomato bowl.

Lift the prepared vegetable plate and use the right fingertips to line cucumber sticks along the spread. Add several handfuls of chopped lettuce, arrange tomato half-moons along the top and return the vegetable plate.
Lift the second ingredient plate and use its spoon to transfer avocado pieces over the tomatoes. Scoop and scatter shredded cheese over the same central filling, then return the plate and spoon.

Lift the near tortilla edge over the filling and pull it snug. Tuck the right and left edges inward while holding the filling enclosed, then roll the bundle forward until the tortilla surrounds the filling.

Retrieve the chef knife and saw crosswise through the wrap while steadying it with the other hand. Rest the knife on the tomato bowl, separate and arrange the two halves with the cut faces visible, then lift and hold the serving plate toward the camera through the final frame.

query: How do I make stuffed dates with goat cheese and almonds?

goal.title: Prepare stuffed dates with white filling and sliced nuts
goal.description: Open six dates by hand, spoon white filling into their cavities, transfer them to a plate and press sliced nuts into the filling.
goal.final_state: Six dates containing white filling and pale sliced-nut toppings remain arranged on a plate; both hands withdraw.

procedure.description: Open the upper cupboard and take out the orange date bag. Pull its opening apart and remove dates one at a time, placing six on the cutting board. Press the bag closed.

Set the bag on the counter, retrieve the hanging dark cloth and wipe the work surface. Return the cloth to its hook. Turn on the faucet, rub both hands under running water, turn the faucet off and dry hands on a hanging towel.

Return to the board and pick up each date in turn. Pull the sides apart with fingers to widen its opening, then place it back on the board. Repeat until six opened dates are aligned in a row. Removal of individual pits is not clearly visible.

Open the utensil drawer, lift a spoon with the left hand and pass it to the right. Scoop white soft filling from an already-open foil wrapper, pick up the first opened date in the left hand and repeatedly spread filling into its cavity. Put the filled date and spoon down.
Leave the kitchen counter and walk into the adjoining room. Press a wall switch; the ceiling light illuminates. Walk back to the dates and retrieve the spoon.

Load the spoon repeatedly from the white filling in its foil wrapper. Pick up the next date with the left hand, spread filling into it and replace it on the board. Repeat for the remaining dates; one date is pulled wider with the left fingers before filling. Finish filling the last date while still holding it.
Return the spoon to the foil wrapper. Use both hands to carry two filled dates to the nearby plate, then transfer the others singly and in a final pair. Adjust the six dates on the plate.

Pick up pale nut slices from the plate with the right fingertips. Hold each date steady with the left hand while pressing slices into the exposed white filling. Repeat across the dates, adjust the arrangement and release the food. The video ends with six garnished dates on the plate; no eating is shown.

goal.title: Replace the smoke detector battery
goal.description: Detach a wall-mounted smoke detector and exchange its rectangular battery. Reopen the compartment to adjust the replacement, test the detector, then twist it back onto its mounting plate.

procedure.description: Approach the wall-mounted detector. Grip and twist it several times, briefly releasing and trying again, until its body begins to detach from the circular mounting plate.
Lower and turn the detector, open its battery door, pull the tray outward and work the blue rectangular battery free. Move the removed battery away from the detector.

Lower the old battery and retrieve another from packaging on the nearby stool. Turn the new battery toward the compartment, slide it inside, close the door and press the front test button while holding the detector.
Open the battery door again, remove the same replacement battery, rotate it in the right hand and make several alignment attempts. Seat it again and press the compartment shut.

Press the test button again; a red indicator illuminates. Change grip, raise the detector to its mounting plate and twist it into place. Check its attachment with both hands, press the mounted test button and withdraw the hands. No audible test result is available.

query: How do I make scrambled eggs?

goal.title: Cook and plate scrambled eggs
goal.description: Crack and beat two eggs, heat an oiled frying pan, pour in the eggs and let them set briefly, then scrape and fold them into curds. Transfer the eggs to a plate and grind pepper and salt over them.
goal.final_state: A plate of scrambled eggs sits on the counter after pepper and salt grinding, with both grinders returned to their rack.

procedure.description: Approach the stove, open upper cupboard doors, take a pale blue mixing bowl from a stack and carry it to the counter beside the egg carton.
Open the cutlery drawer, retrieve a fork, push the drawer shut and put the fork beside the bowl. Open the egg carton, tear a paper towel from its roll and lay it on the counter, then pick up an egg.

Tap and pull open the first egg over the bowl, drain it and put its shell on the towel. Take a second egg from the carton, crack and open it above the bowl, drain its contents and add its shell to the towel.
Hold the bowl in the left hand and beat the two eggs rapidly with the fork until the yolks and whites become a more uniform yellow liquid. Rest the fork in the bowl and put it down.

Open the lower pan storage drawer, retrieve a frying pan and place it on the front right burner. Open the upper cupboard, take an olive oil bottle, close the cupboard and set the bottle on the counter. Turn the stove control several times until blue flame is visible beneath the pan.

Unscrew the green cap, pour a small stream of olive oil into the pan, recap the bottle and set it down. Lift and repeatedly tilt the pan over the flame so the oil moves across the base, then rest the pan on the grate.

Open the utensil drawer, retrieve a black spatula and place it beside the stove. Open the plate cupboard, take a dark green plate and set it on the adjacent counter. Return to the bowl and stir the eggs again with the fork.

goal.title: Replace the sealing washer in a garden hose coupling
goal.description: Set tools and a yellow cloth beside an outdoor faucet, loosen and disconnect the hose, and briefly test the spray nozzle. Work the old rubber washer out of the brass hose coupling using pliers and a screwdriver, then press a replacement washer into the coupling. Reconnect the hose, wipe the faucet area and test the spray again.
goal.final_state: The hose has been reattached to the outdoor faucet and water is sprayed through its nozzle after the washer work. Small removed washers and tools remain near the bucket.
procedure: Place the cloth and tools beside the outdoor faucet.
Loosen the hose connection and check water flow through the nozzle.
Disconnect the hose and expose the washer in the brass coupling.
Use pliers and a screwdriver to free and remove the old washer.
Press a replacement washer into the coupling and check its seating.
Reconnect the hose, wipe the connection area and test the spray nozzle.

phases.description: Set down the cloth and tools, turn the faucet handle and loosen the attached hose coupling with pliers and fingers.

Insert the washer and press around its edge with the fingertips. Set the tool aside and check that the ring lies within the coupling.

task: Making a chocolate peanut butter protein shake
query: How do I make a chocolate peanut butter protein shake?

goal.title: Blend a peanut butter milk drink
goal.description: Set up a blender, measure milk into its pitcher and add spoonfuls of peanut butter and white supplement powder. Blend the mixture, pour it into a glass, rinse the equipment and drink from the glass.
goal.final_state: A glass of beige foamy drink remains partly filled on the counter after a sip; the pitcher and lid have been rinsed in the sink and the blender base moved back.

procedure.description: Pull the blender base forward, lift the pitcher, remove its lid and seat the pitcher on the base. Set the lid down, open the glassware cupboard, retrieve the Pyrex measuring cup, close that door and set the cup on the counter. Open a pantry cupboard.

Search through the pantry, lifting or shifting several tubs, bags, bottles and storage containers. Take out a mixed nuts tin and a large ingredient tub and set them beside the blender. Reposition the other pantry containers and close the doors. Neither of these two large containers is visibly opened or poured into the blender.

Open the adjacent cupboard and look through its contents. Briefly lift and replace a white-lid jar, move a small jar and retrieve the blue-lid peanut butter jar and black-green supplement tub. Put both on the counter, close the pantry, briefly open the glassware cupboard without taking another item, then retrieve the measuring cup and walk toward the refrigerator.

Open the refrigerator, remove the milk jug and return to the blender counter with the cup. Put the cup down, remove the red milk cap and pour milk into the cup. Replace the milk cap, return the jug to the refrigerator door shelf and close the door. Retrieve the measured milk and tip it into the blender pitcher.

Put the empty measuring cup down, pick up the peanut butter jar, unscrew its blue lid and set the lid down. Open the cutlery drawer and take a large spoon. Scoop a heaped spoonful and shake it repeatedly over the pitcher; scoop again and continue shaking until clumps fall into the milk. Carry the used spoon to the sink and leave it there.

Screw the blue lid onto the peanut butter jar. Open the pantry and return the unused large tub and mixed nuts tin, then close that cupboard. Open the adjacent cupboard and put the peanut butter away, close its door, pick up the supplement tub and walk to the drawer. Open the drawer and retrieve a clean smaller spoon.

Open the black-green supplement tub, scoop a spoonful of white powder and tip it into the blender. Replace and tighten the tub lid. Pick up the empty measuring cup while retaining the spoon and leave both in the sink. Carry the closed supplement tub to the pantry and place it on a shelf. The powder is white and the label appears to say creatine; its composition is not inferred from the task title.

Close the pantry and pick up the blender lid. Attempt to fit it, lift it away and reseat it, then press the handle down until secure. Move a metal canister aside to reach the power strip, handle the blender plug and press the power button. Press further controls; the liquid visibly begins churning around 155.1s.

Keep the left palm on the blender lid while the drink churns. Open the pantry again, look inside without retrieving anything, close both doors and briefly steady the lid again. Withdraw the hands and use a phone, including typing, while the blender continues. Lower the phone and press the blender control to stop it.

Manipulate the lid release and handle, lift the pitcher off the base and carry it to the sink counter with the lid resting on top. Put it down, open the glassware cupboard, take a tall ribbed drinking glass and close the door. Put the glass beside the pitcher, lift the blender lid off and leave the lid in the sink.

Hold the glass in the left hand and tilt the pitcher with the right, pouring the beige foamy drink into the glass. Set the filled glass down. Bring the pitcher into the sink, turn the faucet on and leave the pitcher under the stream. Retrieve the lid, rotate and tilt it under running water to rinse both sides, then lower it into the sink.

Rinse the hands, turn the tap off and dry them on the towel hanging from the oven. Return to the blender and slide its base back on the counter. Pick up the filled glass, raise it to the mouth, drink briefly, then lower and set it on the counter. The video ends with the glass still partly filled.

task: Cleaning and reinstalling a range hood filter
query: How do I clean and reinstall a range hood filter?

goal.title: Clean and reinstall the range hood filter assembly
goal.description: Disconnect the hood, remove two metal baffle filters and two round black filter covers, and carry the round covers to the sink. Wash both round covers with dish soap and a sponge, rinse and dry them, then reinstall the covers and metal filters. Reconnect power and operate the hood controls.
goal.final_state: Both metal filters are fitted under the hood and the cord is reconnected. The final frames show the assembled hood with its illuminated display after the controls are tested.
procedure: Disconnect the range hood power cord.
Remove both metal baffle filters and the two round filter covers.
Wash and rinse each round cover using dish soap and a sponge.
Dry the washed covers with paper towels.
Reinstall the round covers, then seat and secure the metal filters.
Reconnect the cord and test the hood controls.

phases.description: Disconnect the cord, release both metal filters and remove both round covers. Carry the round covers to the sink.
Rinse the first cover, obtain a sponge and dish soap, scrub its surfaces and rinse away the soap. Set it back in the sink.
Apply fresh soap to the sponge and scrub the other cover. Rinse it while turning it, then set both washed covers on the counter.
Obtain paper towels, dry both covers and briefly wipe the counter. Collect a dried cover and move back toward the hood.
Attach both round covers inside the hood and fit each metal baffle filter back into its opening. Secure their front edges.
Reconnect the hood power cord and press several controls on the illuminated front panel.

query: How do I make quick microwave chocolate pudding?

goal.title: Make quick microwave chocolate pudding
goal.description: Retrieve a dark mixing bowl from an upper cabinet and carry it to a counter already stocked with cocoa powder, milk, a dish towel and a measuring spoon. Tear open the cocoa box, stir cocoa powder and a second dry ingredient into the bowl, then add milk in two additions while stirring until the batter is smooth. Carry the bowl to the microwave, cook it for roughly a minute and a half, then bring it back to the counter and stir the heated mixture until it thickens into a finished chocolate pudding.
goal.final_state: A smooth brown chocolate pudding sits mixed in the dark bowl at the counter; it has not been plated, tasted, or put away by the end of the video.
procedure: Retrieve a bowl and bring it to the ingredients on the counter.
Open the cocoa package and add cocoa and the visible pale dry ingredient to the bowl.

query: How do I make garlic toast?

goal.title: Make pan-toasted garlic bread
goal.description: Slice a short bread roll into two pieces and set them aside. Crush, slice and repeatedly mince a garlic clove on the board. Put butter in a small bowl, scrape the minced garlic into it and mash and stir the mixture with a spoon. Wipe the board, spread the garlic butter over the cut surfaces of both bread pieces and heat a frying pan on the gas burner. Lay both pieces buttered side down in the pan, wait while adjusting the burner and checking a piece with a spatula, then lift the browned pieces onto a plate and move the pan away.

goal.title: Pan-toast a cheese sandwich and serve it
goal.description: Place two bread slices on a plate and remove a slice of marbled cheese from its packet. Open the spread tub and spread the pale spread over both bread slices with a knife. Put one bread slice in a frying pan, layer the cheese and the second slice on it, and turn on the gas burner. Wait, check the underside repeatedly with a spatula, flip and press the sandwich, then transfer the browned sandwich to the plate. Carry it to the island, wait and take a bite.

goal.title: Prepare salmon toast with herb cream-cheese spread
goal.description: Set two bread slices on a lined plate and heat them in the combination oven. Unwrap cream cheese and spoon some into a metal bowl, add chopped green herbs, salt and small additions of liquid from a brown bottle, then stir into a spread. Remove the warm bread using oven mitts, spread both slices with the herb mixture and top them with separated orange salmon slices. Cut the topped toast and lift a piece toward the mouth.
goal.final_state: Both bread slices are coated with herb cream cheese and topped with salmon. The toast is cut and a piece is lifted for tasting.
procedure: Place two bread slices in the combination oven and set its controls.
Unwrap cream cheese and transfer portions to the mixing bowl.
Add chopped herbs, salt and bottled liquid, then mix thoroughly.
Remove the bread with oven mitts and spread the herb cheese onto both slices.
Separate salmon slices, arrange them over the bread, cut and taste the toast.

goal.title: Prepare oatmeal with warmed apple and nut butter
goal.description: Measure oats and water into a saucepan, heat them on the stove, wash and dice an apple, trim its skin from individual pieces and microwave the prepared fruit. Serve the cooked oats, add the warmed apple and nut butter, and stir together.
goal.final_state: A bowl contains stirred oatmeal with apple pieces and nut butter; the emptied saucepan and apple trimmings remain nearby.

Wash the apple, cut sections away from its core and dice them on the board.
Trim peel from individual apple chunks and collect the prepared pieces in a bowl.
Microwave the apple pieces and wait for the heating cycle.
Remove the apple, stir the oats until thickened and turn off the burner.
Scrape the cooked oats into a serving bowl, add apple and nut butter, and stir until combined.

query: How do I install corner guards for child safety?

goal.title: Install adhesive corner guards on a furniture corner
goal.description: Wipe down a furniture corner with a cloth to prepare the surface, then peel the paper backing off roughly a dozen small clear adhesive corner guards one at a time. Hold up a guard to check it, then press each corner guard firmly onto a corner of the furniture frame in a repeated sequence of short presses, working around to a new corner guard and corner about ten times, with one brief pause to reach into a nearby drawer partway through.
goal.final_state: Roughly ten small clear corner guards have been pressed onto corners of the furniture frame; the last guard is still being pressed into place as the video ends, with peeled paper backings scattered on the desk nearby.
procedure: Wipe the surface near the furniture corner.
Peel adhesive backing and inspect the small clear pieces.
Press the first adhesive pieces into position along the furniture edges.
Continue peeling and pressing additional pieces at successive positions.
Press the remaining pieces into place and check their contact with the surface.

phases.description: Wipe the furniture corner clean with a cloth.
Peel the paper backing off about a dozen individual corner guards.
Hold up a corner guard to inspect it before applying it.
Press a sequence of corner guards firmly onto corners of the furniture frame, one after another.

notes: This video is dominated by a single repeated micro-action: the human fine-track splits one continuous 'press the corner guard onto the furniture corner' motion into roughly 90 sub-second segments (many 0.1s long) across about ten corner-guard applications, interspersed with a few longer press segments and occasional brief re-peels of another guard's backing. All of these were reviewed via dense and sparse contact sheets; the pressing motion and held object are visually consistent throughout, so steps within each press cluster share the same description by design (flagged as repeated-summary warnings, not errors) rather than inventing false visual distinctions. Step 32 (105.3-105.4s, 0.1s) is labeled in the source as 'hand reaches into drawer', an outlier amid the pressing sequence; it is kept as a brief, low-confidence reach rather than reinterpreted as another press. The exact furniture piece is not identified from the frames (a reflective metal-framed item, possibly a lamp base or small stand, sits beside the work area but is not clearly the object receiving the guards), so it is tracked generically as 'furniture corner'. Fine track ends 9.93s before ffprobe_duration (165.134s); this is a large gap but no additional source segments cover it, so no step was added per the no-alter-boundaries rule - the gap is flagged here per the tail-note requirement.

task: Applying felt pads to chair or table legs
query: How do I apply felt pads to chair or chair legs?

goal.title: Apply felt pads to a small chair's legs
goal.description: Flip a small white wooden chair upside down and clean each turned-wood leg first with disposable wipes from a container and then with a cloth. Peel felt pads one at a time from a backing sheet and press each onto the bottom of a chair leg, adjusting and re-pressing several pads to seat them firmly. Finish by rotating the chair to check that a felt pad is seated on every leg.
goal.final_state: All four legs of the chair have a felt pad pressed onto their bottom tip; the chair is still upside down and being rotated for a final check as the video ends.
procedure: Turn the furniture upside down and take a disposable wipe.
Wipe the exposed wooden legs with wipes and a cloth.
Peel felt pads from the backing sheet and press them onto leg ends.
Continue applying and adjusting pads on the other leg ends.
Rotate the furniture and press or inspect the fitted pads.

phases.description: Flip the chair over and get out a container of wipes.
Wipe each chair leg clean, first with disposable wipes and then with a cloth.
Peel felt pads from the backing sheet and press them onto the chair legs.
Finish pressing and adjusting the pads, then rotate the chair to check all the legs.

goal.description: Open the breaker panel and operate a switch, then enter the bathroom and remove the blue grille cover by undoing its two fasteners. Wipe both sides and slats of the cover with a pink cloth and wipe the exposed housing. Prepare the cover screws and repeatedly attempt to realign the grille, set down the screwdriver and reseat the cover, then start the fasteners by hand and tighten the right fastener with the screwdriver. Press the mounted cover, set the tool on the step stool, return to the breaker panel, operate the switch again and close the panel.
goal.final_state: The blue cover is refitted over the wall housing and the breaker panel is closed. No audio or airflow evidence establishes fan operation.

procedure.description: Reach up, open the breaker panel, flip a switch and withdraw the hand. The switch label and direction cannot be established from the frames.
Move into the bathroom, steady the cover and unscrew its right and left fasteners by hand. Pull the cover away, take it to the sink counter and set down the cover and loose screws.

Take the pink cloth and wipe the front, rear, slats and edges of the cover. Set the cover down, raise the cloth to the open housing, wipe the accessible rim/interior, then return and set the cloth aside.

Take a fastener, position it in a cover hole, collect the screwdriver and bring the cover back to the wall. Try to align and thread the fastener, adjust the cover repeatedly, then remove it and set the screwdriver down.
Raise and reseat the cover repeatedly, turn the left screw by hand and then work the right screw. Retrieve the screwdriver after the cover is held in position.
Position the driver on the right screw and turn it repeatedly. Finish the visible tightening, press the cover, descend and place the screwdriver on the step stool.
Return to the open breaker panel, flip the switch and close the panel door.

query: How do I make a microwave egg sandwich?

goal.title: Make a microwave-cooked egg sandwich
goal.description: Crack and beat an egg in a bowl, microwave it under a cover in several short cycles with checks and stirring, then loosen the cooked egg onto bread and close the sandwich.
goal.final_state: A closed egg sandwich rests on a folded paper towel on the counter.
procedure: Crack egg into bowl, discard shell beside bread and add a small amount of water from the cup.
Beat the egg thoroughly with a fork.
Put the bowl in the microwave, cover it and heat, checking and stirring between short heating cycles.
Remove the cooked egg, loosen it with a fork and tip it onto a bread slice.
Place the second bread slice on top, press sandwich and fold paper towel beneath it.

goal.title: Replace the toilet paper dispenser with a wall holder
goal.description: Unscrew and remove the existing silver dispenser, place it on the floor, and initially position a gold-coloured single-arm holder using a manual screwdriver and a thin screwdriver at its joint. Use a cordless driver, remove the holder again and rest it on the toilet tank. Drill the exposed wall mounting hole, open the anchor case and drive a white anchor into the wall. Retrieve and position the holder, fasten it with the cordless driver, check the joint and repeatedly rework the mounting fasteners, briefly realigning the fixture. procedure.description: Steady the silver dispenser, use the manual screwdriver to undo its two mounting screws, pull it away and handle its back. Lower it onto the floor beside the toilet and leave the screwdriver on the counter.

Pick up the cordless driver and work the holder fastener. Withdraw the driver, lift the holder away, place the holder on the toilet tank and put the driver on the counter.

Bring the cordless driver back to the holder.
